content: Windows: SQLite uses LockFileEx byte-range locks; antivirus and search indexing can hold transient locks causing intermittent SQLITE_BUSY; files open in another handle cannot be deleted (ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION), so t.TempDir cleanup fails unless the cache is closed before test end and even then -wal/-shm sidecar handles may linger briefly (Go testing retries). A pending transaction can block database/sql Close from closing the underlying handle. Cross-process locking works on local NTFS but fails on network shares, ReFS Dev Drives or synced folders. Do not test file permission bits on Windows (WriteFile 0755 becomes 0666).
